collection.title: Volvo S60 2010 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo S60 2010 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
